In doc/README.md: add row #27 'number' to the quick-reference table at the bottom, after math (#26): '| 27 | `number` | Number parsing (parse string to int/float) |'
acceptance_criteria: doc/README.md says '27 builtins' (not 26) in all places
doc/README.md quick-reference table has 27 rows matching BUILTINS.md

grep -c 'number' doc/README.md should return at least 1 (the table row)
